sections.title: 11. German International Business FAQs

items: Q1: Is it possible to **study International Business in English in Germany?**
It is a matter of degree and enrollment . But a number of universities offer ** International Business or International Management programs ** taught in English .
Q2. What is the length of the international business course in Germany?
Master’s degrees typically take 1–2 years to complete, while bachelor’s degrees usually require 3–3.5 years.
Q3. Is it expensive to do business internationally in Germany?
Many **public universities** are relatively inexpensive to attend, although there are exceptions. Students also need to budget for **living costs, insurance and semester fees**.
Q4. Could Indian students apply for admission in Germany to study international business after their 12th grade studies?

Yes, but direct admission depends on the prerequisites of the university and the school-leaving qualification. Some candidates may have to attend a **Studienkolleg and pass the evaluation examination** before they can begin a bachelor’s degree.
Q5. What kind of jobs can I get in Germany after studying international business?
Graduates can seek employment in international sales, export-import operations, marketing, logistics, procurement, business analysis, consultancy and global account management.
